newsitem.title: ITALY: Venetian gondoliers win okay to serenade by day.
newsitem.headline: Venetian gondoliers win okay to serenade by day.

text.p: Romantics in the lagoon city of Venice need no longer wait all day to be serenaded as they glide along in a gondolier.
The city's regional council on Wednesday approved a change to the "Waterway Code" enabling gondoliers to offer their serenade service all day, not just in the evenings and at night.

Several councillors, including mayor Massimo Cacciari, voted against the new rule, which allows gondolas to proceed along Venice's Grand Canal three-abreast, fearing it could clog up the overcrowded waterways even more.
